In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
a monitoring strategy for the SCIs should be based on the evaluation of the compositional changes in species assemblages among SCIs and not on the evaluation of species richness.
the Natura 2 00 network in the study area is not effective in preserving plant species diversity.
the SCIs network in Siena Province is not able to preserve the whole regional flora diversity, as the majority of species are not included in any of the red list categories.
